description: Fork of exp321 (dense + RoPE) replacing separate qk_joint (NAP=6, tph=256, n_out=2*d_qk=128) and v_lut (NAP=8, tph=256, n_out=d_v=32) modules with a SINGLE qkv_joint TinyMHL per layer using NAP=6, tph=256 and n_out = 2*d_qk + d_v = 160. q/k get q_norm/k_norm + RoPE; v passes through unrotated. Per-layer LUT params: 12.6M + 12.6M = 25.2M (separate) -> 1536*64*160 = 15.7M (joint). Total model ~602M -> ~545M (-57M; smaller). Hypothesis: sharing lookup tables across q/k/v lets the network jointly route the same anchor decisions into all three projections.
